note: Signs in by SMS each run, which costs one of five codes an hour against the corporate number. Needs at least one corporate invoice to exist: the seed ships none, and the three invoices in the database are customer invoices left by e2e lanes. A bulk order raises its invoice ISSUED at submission, so placing one through the portal is how the figure gets its row.

steps.eval: (() => { const p = [...document.querySelectorAll('*')].find(e => e.children.length === 0 && /^\d{6}$/.test(e.textContent.trim())); if (p) window.__code = p.textContent.trim(); })()

(() => { const i = document.querySelector('input[name=code]'); const set = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; set.call(i, window.__code); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()
